name: Reaper Soul Bane rank 2 reduces Reliquary of the Lost's cooldown (#2149)
contract: Soul Bane rank 705392 reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Reliquary of the Lost by 5 sec.' (only this rank is obtainable; rank 800935 is absent from the calibrated capture, see coa-obtainable).
Spell.dbc gives 705392 a single effect: aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) with MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -5001 and DieSides 1, family 36, EffectSpellClassMask[0] = 32.
Reliquary of the Lost's cast-cooldown rank 500631 carries SpellFamilyName 36 and SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 32, an exact class-mask match, and RecoveryTime 20000.
SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER is a native, generic SpellMod (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod); no CoA-specific code is required.
A Reaper who learns 705392 must show a SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN modifier of exactly -5001 on 500631, while an untalented Reaper shows none.

steps.label: Control has no Soul Bane cooldown modifier
Reliquary of the Lost cooldown modifier is exactly -5000
